title: Replace temporary dashboard seed with shared demo seed contract
description: Align the cloned Aria frontend with src/data/schema and src/data/seed. Phase 1 added a classic-script adapter that mirrored the canonical seed statically; Phase 2 (done) boots the canonical schema (copy of drizzle/0000_init.sql) + seed + SO-1 transaction chain in PGlite (idb://erp-system-demo), reads all screen data back with async SQL, and adds a Settings > Demo data reset that drops and reseeds. Static fallback keeps the demo rendering when the PGlite CDN is unreachable.
acceptance: Adapter maps canonical master/company/product/customer/tax/account data into Aria DB
Dashboard, inventory, sales invoices, and GL render Acme SG/S$ demo data without runtime errors
Demo boot uses canonical schema or generated SQL
Reset demo reseeds canonical sample data
